title: Marlowe Rewards Keep Discount on Delivery Claims Wrong Items
content:
Loyalty partnership note for Delivery Claims: a long-standing Marlowe Rewards member who keeps a wrong item receives a keep discount on the wrong-item keep charge.

**Discount.** The keep discount depends on the customer's active Marlowe Rewards membership: Platinum, Icon or Atelier held on a membership open for 120 months or more gives 25%; Silver or Gold held on a membership open for 60 months or more gives 15%; any other customer gets no keep discount.

- Active tier: the tier of the customer's Marlowe Rewards membership in status active — Marlowe Rewards Platinum, Icon or Atelier, or Marlowe Rewards Silver or Gold.
- Months open: months from that membership's enrolment date to today.

| Active tier | Membership open | Keep discount |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum, Icon or Atelier | 120 months or more | 25% |
| Platinum, Icon or Atelier | under 120 months | none |
| Silver or Gold | 60 months or more | 15% |
| Silver or Gold | under 60 months | none |
| Member, or no active membership | any | none |

## Edge cases (hypothetical members)

- Atelier, 120 months: 25%. Atelier, 119 months: none.
- Silver, 60 months: 15%. Silver, 59 months: none.
- Platinum, 70 months: none — the 15% discount belongs to Silver and Gold.
